title: The Broken Bridge
text: The bridge the Lost crossed is down, its ropes trailing in the gorge. The cuts are clean. They cut it behind them, on purpose, to stop whatever was following. On this side of the gorge, whatever it was is still pacing up and down.

options.label: Rebuild the bridge, with your backs to the thing pacing behind you.

outcomes.text: The work is slow. Whatever the Lost fled is still here, and it has grown tired of waiting.

options.label: The quickest climbs down and across the gorge, to throw a rope back for the rest.

outcomes.text: They make it across with hands torn on the rock, then lower a rope for the rest.

options.label: Find another crossing, rather than turn your backs on whatever paces there.

outcomes.text: A day is lost, and the Lost are further away. Every hour counts against them.
